entry.pre_arrival: Confirm the visa-free policy is still in force for the travel date and carry the invitation or activity purpose.
entry.max_stay: Up to 30 calendar days under the current policy, through 31 December 2026.

tourism.detail: The policy covers tourism for Australian ordinary-passport holders and currently permits multiple entries.
tourism.next: Recheck the policy end date and passport conditions shortly before departure.

meetings.route: 30-day visa-free business visit; M visa for a longer or visa-required trip
meetings.detail: Meetings, negotiations and commercial visits fit the published business purpose.
meetings.next: Carry a host invitation and keep service delivery outside the meeting-only brief.

conference.detail: Conferences and exhibitions are expressly named in the current visa-free policy.
conference.next: Keep registration, invitation, accommodation and onward travel together.

unpaid-speaking.route: Visa-free exchange or F visa only when the host and authorities classify it as non-commercial exchange
unpaid-speaking.detail: F covers exchanges and visits; it is not an automatic performance exemption. A programmed appearance may still need cultural approval even without a fee.
unpaid-speaking.next: Ask the host to confirm the classification and any cultural approval in writing before using the exchange lane.

paid-speaking.route: Host-sponsored short-term work approval plus Z visa
paid-speaking.detail: A paid lecture, advisory session or professional service generally fits short-term work rather than business attendance.
paid-speaking.next: Have the contracting host start the work-approval process before the Z application.

book-launch.route: Split rights meetings, cultural appearance, speaking fee and retail sales
book-launch.detail: Publisher and rights meetings can fit business entry; a non-commercial appearance may fit exchange; paid delivery or personal sales change the route.
book-launch.next: Use a Chinese publisher or bookseller for local sales and classify the appearance separately.

ai-teaching.route: Short-term work approval and Z visa for up to 90 days
ai-teaching.detail: Paid technical, management or advisory teaching is treated as work; longer roles use the normal work-permit and residence process.
ai-teaching.next: Ask the university, company or event host to sponsor the exact teaching dates and duties.

remote-work.route: No dedicated national digital-nomad route identified
remote-work.detail: The current visa-free policy excludes people coming to work, and the official visa list has no remote-worker class.
remote-work.next: Map a city-specific residence or work route if China becomes a longer base.

entrepreneur.route: Business scouting first; city-specific entrepreneurship residence for a longer build
entrepreneur.detail: Foreigners can invest and establish enterprises subject to sector rules; Shanghai also publishes entrepreneurship residence pathways.
entrepreneur.next: Choose the city and entity role, then map investment approval separately from personal work status.

trade.route: 30-day visa-free business visit or M visa
trade.detail: Trade fairs, sourcing, negotiations and setup meetings fit the business lane.
trade.next: Separate negotiations from any local installation, operation or service delivery.

artist.route: Written exchange classification for non-commercial activity; cultural approval plus short-term employment approval plus Z visa for commercial performance
artist.detail: For a commercial performance of 90 days or less, the official short-work process requires both cultural-authority documents and short-term employment approval before the Z route.
artist.next: Have the promoter classify the engagement and coordinate all cultural, employment and visa documents.

mixed-mission.route: Build a host-backed activity schedule, then choose visa-free exchange, M, F or Z
mixed-mission.detail: China has several workable keys; the correct one follows the real actions and remuneration.
mixed-mission.next: Send one precise schedule to the principal Chinese host for route classification.
